title: Impact on Singapore of US Pull-out from Trans-Pacific Partnership
what_it_is: Impact on Singapore of US Pull-out from Trans-Pacific Partnership

sections.label: TPP without US, other trade initiatives
sections.summary: With the US withdrawal, the signed TPP cannot come into effect, so each partner must study benefits without the US, while Singapore pursues RCEP, AEC and 21 FTAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: With the US' withdrawal, the TPP agreement, as signed, cannot come into effect.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: This is a setback for the global trade liberalising agenda but need not be the ultimate outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: Each TPP partner will now have to carefully study the new balance of benefits without the US' participation and consider the value of an agreement among the remaining 11 partners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: In addition to consulting with other TPP partners to find a mutually beneficial pathway forward, Singapore is also actively engaged in other regional integration initiatives, such as the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) and the ASEAN Economic Community (AEC).

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: On the bilateral front, Singapore has an existing network of 21 free trade agreements (FTAs) in force, including with the eight TPP countries and the US.

sections.label: RCEP negotiation round in Tianjin
sections.summary: The last RCEP negotiation round was held in Tianjin in October 2016, with completion planned within about three to four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: I understand that the last round of negotiation of RCEP was held in Tianjin back in October 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: We were planning to complete it within a reasonable timeframe of about three to four years.

sections.label: TPP three separate objectives
sections.summary: The TPP initiative put together three separate objectives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: The TPP initiative put together three separate objectives.

sections.label: TPP-11 depends on benefit assessment
sections.summary: Whether TPP-11 can proceed depends on the 11 countries assessing benefits without the US as the major market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: Whether we can proceed with TPP-11, as I mentioned, depends on the assessment of the benefits that the 11 countries will now have to calculate without the US as the major market.

sections.label: Two-year ratification process target
sections.summary: The original agreement was to complete ratification within two years of signing on 5 or 6 February last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: The original agreement was that we will all try and get our ratification process done within two years of the signing of the Agreement, which was 5 or 6 February last year.

sections.label: TPP-11 ratify and wait for US
sections.summary: One possible pathway is for the TPP-11 to continue ratification and wait until the US is ready or changes its mind, then join.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: One possible pathway is for countries, the TPP-11, to continue their ratification process and wait until the US is ready or changes its mind, then they will join.

sections.label: Bilateral FTAs with trading partners
sections.summary: There are 21 bilateral FTAs covering all of Singapore's major trading partners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: On bilateral, we have, as I mentioned just now, 21 FTAs, and these cover all our major trading partners.

sections.label: Trade facilitation agreement ratification
sections.summary: In 2013 they agreed on trade facilitation agreements and are close to ratifying it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: For example, in 2013, we got together and agreed on the trade facilitation agreements, and I think we are quite close to ratifying it.
